definition.name: hilbert_schmidt_measure
definition.definition: The rank-r Hilbert-Schmidt measure mu_HS^{d,r} is the probability measure on d×d mixed states induced by the Haar measure on pure states in C^d tensor C^r. Specifically, draw |u> uniformly from the unit sphere in C^{dr}, then set sigma = tr_2(|u><u|). The resulting distribution on sigma is mu_HS^{d,r}. When r = d, this coincides with the standard Hilbert-Schmidt measure on d×d density matrices. The rank-r HS measure concentrates on states of rank min(d,r).
